caption: The video captures a night harbor scene where three firework displays hang in a dark sky above a silhouetted shoreline. Low buildings, moored boats, and a row of warm quay lights line the water, their reflections shimmering on the calm surface. On the left, a spherical burst of purple dots trails short white sparks that lengthen and drift downward, while faint vertical trails occupy the center. On the right, a dome of purple dots remains largely stationary above a fan of white streaks that grow longer and splay outward as the sparks descend. The water reflection beneath the right burst becomes noticeably more defined as the white trails extend, while the shoreline lights and building silhouettes stay fixed. Overall, the central trails fade while the purple domes hold their shape and the white sparks continue lengthening downward.
